structures.name: Empty book
structures.hint: No chapters, no notes. You build it all.

structures.name: Three acts
structures.hint: Beginning, middle and end, with the turns that carry a novel.

parts.title: Beginning
chapters: The main character in their everyday life, and what is missing there.
Something happens that cannot be ignored.
The main character chooses to take it on.

parts.title: Middle
chapters: A new situation, new friends and new enemies.
Everything turns: a revelation or a false victory.
The opposition grows and every mistake costs more.
The lowest point. The goal seems impossible.

parts.title: End
chapters: The main character understands what really has to be done.
How the world and the main character have changed.

structures.name: Three acts with an inner journey
structures.hint: What happens outside, and what the main character learns inside: the inner journey carries the story.

parts.title: The lie
chapters: The ordinary world and the lie
Outside: life as it is. Inside: the false belief that rules the main character.
Outside: something upsets everyday life. Inside: the lie is challenged for the first time.
Outside: the main character hesitates. Inside: fear clings to the lie.
Outside: the decision to act. Inside: a first doubt.

parts.title: The struggle
chapters: Outside: the goal is chased the wrong way. Inside: the lie still rules the choices.
Outside: a turn. Inside: the truth is glimpsed for the first time.
Outside: the obstacles grow. Inside: lie and truth fight over the main character.
Outside: everything seems lost. Inside: the lie has to die.

parts.title: The truth
chapters: Outside: the main character acts on the truth. Inside: the change happens.
Outside: the goal is reached, or let go. Inside: the main character is someone else now.

structures.name: Fifteen beats
structures.hint: Fifteen beats, each in its place in the book, in percent.

chapters: 1%. A picture of life before the change.
5%. Someone says, without knowing it, what the book is about.
1–10%. The main character, the world and what needs to change.
10%. The event that sets everything in motion.
22%. A new person or relationship that carries the theme.
20–50%. The promise of the premise, what the reader came for.
50%. A false victory or a false defeat. The stakes rise.
75%. The lowest point, often with a whiff of death.
75–80%. The main character takes in the loss.
80%. The solution, thanks to the B story.
80–99%. The plan is carried out, and rethought.
99–100%. The mirror of the opening image: this is how everything changed.

structures.name: The hero's journey
structures.hint: Twelve steps from home and back, for fantasy and adventure.

parts.title: Departure
chapters: The hero at home, before the adventure.
A problem or a challenge appears.
The hero hesitates before the unknown.
Someone gives advice, courage or a gift.

parts.title: Initiation
chapters: The rules of the new world are learned.
The hero faces their greatest fear.
Something is won, at a price.

parts.title: Return
chapters: The consequences chase the hero home.
A last test where everything is at stake.
The hero comes home changed, with something to give.

structures.name: The romance in four phases
structures.hint: Two who meet, fall, pull back and fight for love. The ending is happy.

parts.title: The meeting
chapters: Them, their wound and what is missing in their life.
Them, their wound and why love is not on the map.
They meet, and something grates or sparks.
Something forces them to keep meeting.

parts.title: Falling in love
chapters: A look or a moment that will not be forgotten.
They see each other as they are.
The kiss, the night or the promise. It seems to hold.

parts.title: The retreat
chapters: The old wound makes itself felt.
One pulls back to stay safe.
It ends, for a reason rooted in the wound.

parts.title: Fighting for love
chapters: Life without the other, and what it costs.
What love looks like when it holds.

structures.name: Romantasy
structures.hint: The romance's four phases braided with a fantasy plot: the world makes the obstacles, and love decides the battle.

parts.title: Two worlds
chapters: The main character, the burden and what they are willing to do.
The two meet, and the friction sparks.
A secret and a world of their own.
A quest, a pact or a bond ties them together.

parts.title: Drawn closer
chapters: A power or a heritage begins to show, and it has a price.
A moment that almost becomes more.
The first kiss, as the fantasy plot turns.

parts.title: Betrayal and choice
chapters: A secret comes out and everything falls apart.
They go separate ways when all seems lost.

parts.title: What remains
chapters: The grand gesture is part of the deciding battle.
A happy ending, or a promise that holds until the next book.

structures.name: The mystery in four parts
structures.hint: The crime, the investigation, the turn and the solution.

parts.title: The crime
chapters: The crime is found in the first chapter, or within the first tenth of the book.
Who investigates, and why it is them.
The scene, the witnesses and the suspects. The culprit is already among them.

parts.title: The investigation
chapters: An obvious suspect who is not the answer.
A clue that points the wrong way, and the reader follows.
The stakes rise and time runs short.
The case comes close to the investigator.

parts.title: The turn
chapters: A detail the reader has seen all along: the solution must be possible to work out.
The culprit realises the truth is close.
The investigator and the culprit meet.

parts.title: The solution
chapters: How it was done, and why.
What the case cost, and what lies ahead.

structures.name: The thriller in four parts
structures.hint: A threat, a chase, a twist and a reckoning against the clock.

parts.title: The threat
chapters: The main character and what they stand to lose.
Something is wrong, and no one else sees it.

parts.title: The chase
chapters: The threat gets a face, or a plan.

parts.title: The twist
chapters: A truth turns everything upside down.
Help fails; the main character stands alone.

parts.title: The reckoning
chapters: Everything is decided in little time.
What has changed, and what it cost.

structures.name: The staircase of horror
structures.hint: The everyday cracks, step by step, until nothing is safe.

parts.title: The everyday
chapters: Where it will all happen, before anything has.
A small thing that does not add up.

parts.title: It grows
chapters: The main character is alone with it.
What it is, and what it wants.

parts.title: The worst
chapters: Face to face with the fear.

structures.name: Feel-good and romantic comedy
structures.hint: A new start, a meeting that grates, warmth, a setback and a warm ending.

parts.title: The new start
chapters: Something ends and something new must begin.
A town, a shop or a house to land in.
Two who should not fit together at all.

parts.title: The warmth
chapters: The people around them begin to matter.

parts.title: The setback
chapters: The new life is at stake: the place may be lost, or the past comes back.
It looks like it is over.

parts.title: Home
chapters: The people around step up, and someone dares to say what needs saying.
Life as it turned out, better than the plan, and hopeful.

structures.name: Young adult
structures.hint: Finding yourself: friends, first times and a choice that changes everything.

parts.title: Before
chapters: The main character, the family and the friends.
A new school, a new friend or a secret.

parts.title: In the middle
chapters: Something happens for the first time.
Something the main character hides grows.

structures.name: Chapter book for children
structures.hint: Short chapters of a few pages, a clear question, an adventure and a safe ending. The child solves it.

chapters: The main character and what they wish for.
Out into the unknown, with a friend.
A problem that seems too big.
The main character solves it, in their own way.
Safe, but not quite as before.

structures.name: Memoir
structures.hint: A life told around one question: what happened, and what did it mean.

parts.title: Where from
chapters: A scene that shows what the book is about.
The place, the people and what shaped you.

parts.title: What happened
chapters: The hard part, and how you got through it.
Those who mattered most, for better or worse.

parts.title: What it meant
chapters: What you see now that you did not see then.

structures.name: Non-fiction
structures.hint: A question, the knowledge that answers it and what the reader can do with it.

chapters: The question the book answers, and why it matters.
What the reader needs to know first.
The first big idea, with examples.
The next idea, built on the first.
The hardest, or the most surprising.
How the reader uses it in their own life.

structures.name: Short story
structures.hint: Five short steps for a story of a few thousand words: start late, one conflict, few characters.

chapters: A first sentence or image that raises a question.
What the main character wants, and what stands in the way.

pieces.name: Mystery
pieces.hint: The clues and the suspects, so the solution can be worked out. The timeline follows When on the chapters.

pieces.name: Romance
pieces.hint: A love story through the plot, with a happy ending.

pieces.name: Fantasy and magic
pieces.hint: A magic system with rules, costs and limits, realms and creatures.

pieces.name: Urban fantasy
pieces.hint: A city we know, with a hidden world beneath.

pieces.name: Two narrators
pieces.hint: A label for each voice, so it shows whose chapter it is.

pieces.name: Thriller
pieces.hint: The villain's plan, the deadlines and the twists.

pieces.name: Horror
pieces.hint: What frightens and the rules of the supernatural.

pieces.name: Science fiction
pieces.hint: The technology, the worlds and the society of the future.

pieces.name: Historical novel
pieces.hint: The era, the sources, what really happened and where you took liberties.

pieces.name: Literary novel
pieces.hint: Themes and motifs that recur through the book.

pieces.name: Children's book
pieces.hint: The pictures and the words for the reader.

pieces.name: Memoir
pieces.hint: Memories, letters and documents from a life.

pieces.name: Facts and sources
pieces.hint: The sources, the quotations and what needs evidence.

pieces.name: Series
pieces.hint: Threads that run between the books, and a last chapter that leads on.
chapters: A new threat or a secret that leads to the next book.
